prod_aes001_desc: Surgical Kocher clamp by Aesculap (B.Braun). Made from high-quality stainless steel X10CrNi18-8. Suitable for grasping and holding tissues during surgery. Conforms to ISO 7153-1 standard.
prod_aes002_desc: Mayo operating scissors by Aesculap with straight sharp blades. Designed for cutting dense tissue and aponeuroses. Made from surgical stainless steel, suitable for repeated autoclave sterilization.
prod_aes003_desc: Aesculap surgical forceps with 1×2 teeth for reliable tissue grasping. Classic design used in general surgery. Made from stainless steel, withstands multiple sterilization cycles.
prod_ks001_desc: Rigid endoscope Karl Storz with 0° viewing angle and 4mm diameter. Used in arthroscopy, urology and gynecology. The Hopkins II optical system provides exceptional brightness and image clarity.
prod_ks002_desc: Professional laparoscope Karl Storz with 30° viewing angle, 10mm diameter. HOPKIN II optical system. Designed for laparoscopic operations in general surgery, gynecology and urology.
prod_dra001_desc: Universal anesthesia workstation Dräger Primus IE. Supports all ventilation modes (VCV, PCV, SIMV, PSV). Features a 15-inch touchscreen, respiratory monitoring and anesthetic agent monitoring systems.
prod_dra002_desc: Stationary ICU ventilator Dräger Evita Infinity V500 for adult and pediatric patients. Supports an extended set of ventilation modes. Equipped with a lung function monitoring system.
prod_phi001_desc: Expert-class ultrasound system Philips EPIQ Elite with nSIGHT technology. 23-inch 4K monitor, compatible with 30+ transducers. Built-in AI image analysis for cardiology, radiology and obstetrics.
prod_phi002_desc: Universal bedside patient monitor Philips IntelliVue MX800. Monitors ECG, SpO2, NIBP, temperature and CO2. Stores 72 hours of trend data. Connects to IntelliVue telemonitoring systems.
prod_str001_desc: Battery-powered surgical drill Stryker System 7 for orthopedic procedures. Speed up to 1500 rpm, ergonomic handle, lightweight 0.85 kg. Compatible with a wide range of System 7 attachments.
prod_str002_desc: Total knee replacement system Stryker Triathlon TKA. Made from high-quality Co-Cr-Mo and Ti-6Al-4V alloys. X3 polyethylene insert with reduced wear. All anatomical sizes available.
prod_jnj001_desc: Absorbable synthetic suture Ethicon Vicryl 2/0 on CT-1 atraumatic needle. Provides reliable tissue support for 3–4 weeks, fully absorbed in 56–70 days. Used in general surgery, gynecology.
prod_jnj002_desc: Non-absorbable monofilament suture Ethicon Prolene 3/0 (polypropylene) on SH needle. Causes no tissue reaction. Widely used in vascular and cardiac surgery.
prod_med001_desc: Next-generation robotic surgical system Medtronic Hugo RAS. 4 instrument arms, 3D HD visualization with 10x magnification. Supports laparoscopic and thoracoscopic procedures. Open platform with third-party instrument support.
prod_ste001_desc: Low-temperature hydrogen peroxide sterilizer STERIS V-PRO maX+. 148L chamber volume, 28–55 minute cycle. Designed for sterilization of heat-sensitive medical devices.
prod_bec001_desc: Fully automated hematology analyzer Beckman Coulter DxH 900. Throughput up to 100 samples per hour, 5-part WBC differential. Built-in AI algorithms for flag detection and morphological anomalies.
prod_ge001_desc: Expert-class ultrasound system GE LOGIQ E10 with cSound architecture. Built-in artificial intelligence for automatic image analysis. 21.5" Full HD monitor, advanced 3D/4D visualization.
prod_zim001_name: Knee System Zimmer Biomet Persona TKA
prod_zim001_desc: Total knee replacement system Zimmer Biomet Persona. Wide size range A1-F9 for optimal anatomical fit. Innovative RP™ tibial platform reduces instability risk.
